description: Free, no key needed: run one of Kula Labs' own products for real, 3 times a day (with a key, your own 3; without, a shared pool). Swiss QR code, IBAN check, UID check, JSON repair, cron, calendar invite and more: pick a listing by Kula Labs from ask_market or search_listings, pass its listing_id and an input matching its input_schema (get_listing). Nothing is charged or stored; the answer shows the result and how to buy more.

input.description: the input the product needs, matching input_schema from get_listing

listing_id.description: a listing sold by Kula Labs (ask_market, search_listings)
